_: Btown Challenges, shown in What Now above the Top 100. Stephen edits this file by hand; nothing builds it. weekly: one shows each week (Monday to Sunday, Burlington time), going down the list and starting over at the end; give one a "week" (that week's Monday, YYYY-MM-DD) to pin it to that week instead. evergreen: three show at a time and the three change every week. kind is eat, climb, explore or streak, and picks the colour. url is where the challenge lives: the challenge board's own page (play.btownbrief.com/challenges/?c=<id>) or a guide page like ../sunset.html. Reader ideas come in by email to suggest.

weekly.title: A new sunset spot
weekly.line: Watch one sunset this week from somewhere you never have.

weekly.title: Go to one thing alone
weekly.line: Pick an event off the calendar and go by yourself. Talk to one person there.

weekly.title: Three car-free days
weekly.line: Walk, bike or take the bus everywhere for three days this week.

weekly.title: The place you always walk past
weekly.line: Eat at the spot you have walked by a hundred times and never tried.

weekly.title: Give an hour
weekly.line: Volunteer one hour somewhere in town this week.

weekly.title: Get to the top of something
weekly.line: Hike one peak this week. Mt. Philo, Snake Mountain, Camel's Hump, your pick.

weekly.title: Five coffees, five places
weekly.line: A different local coffee spot every weekday, no repeats.

weekly.title: Go to a game
weekly.line: UVM, high school or rec league. Any local game with a scoreboard counts.

weekly.title: Take a class
weekly.line: Sign up for one class or workshop you have never tried.

weekly.title: Walk the old town
weekly.line: Do the Btown Brief walking tour, start to finish.

evergreen.title: The Sunset Tour
evergreen.line: Catch a sunset from every spot on the Btown Brief sunset guide.

evergreen.title: The Creemee Crawl
evergreen.line: One creemee from five different stands in a single summer. At least one maple.

evergreen.title: The Vermont 5
evergreen.line: Summit Mansfield, Killington, Camel's Hump, Ellen and Abraham, the state's five 4,000-footers.

evergreen.title: Dawn Patrol
evergreen.line: Watch five sunrises from the waterfront in one month.

evergreen.title: Park Passport
evergreen.line: Set foot in every Burlington city park. Yes, all of them.

evergreen.title: Four Seasons, One Summit
evergreen.line: Summit the same Vermont peak in all four seasons within one year.

evergreen.title: The Local Ten
evergreen.line: Buy something from ten different locally owned shops. Farmers market stalls count.

evergreen.title: The Long Swim
evergreen.line: Swim in the lake at least once a month, May through October.

evergreen.title: Island Line End to End
evergreen.line: Ride the Island Line Trail end to end, causeway and bike ferry included.

evergreen.title: Long Trail End-to-Ender
evergreen.line: Hike all 272 miles of the Long Trail, Massachusetts to Canada.
